newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt airport has 3pct more passengers in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt airport has 3pct more passengers in Feb.

text.p: Demand for flights to Asia, the Caribbean and North Africa boosted passenger numbers at Frankfurt airport by 2.3 percent in February, airport authority figures showed.
Without the statistical blip caused by the extra day in February last year, growth would have reached six percent last month, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.
But domestic passenger numbers to German destinations were down 2.8 percent on last February due to economic reasons and the lack of transit passengers, it added.
The average number of passengers per flight departing Frankfurt rose 4.8 percent to 90.3 in February, the report said.
